visual.general_description: Color intraoral photograph of the soft palate and tongue.
visual.detailed_description: Color close-up photograph of the back of an open mouth. The pink soft palate fills the upper two thirds of the frame, with a pale midline raised ridge running down its center. A recess is visible on each side of the midline; the one on the right of the image contains a rounded, smooth, pink bulge with glossy highlights. The upper surface of the tongue, with a central groove, occupies the lower part of the frame. No teeth, lips, text, labels, arrows or scale are visible.
